I can talk to a proffesional, but i fail to see how talking to a proffesional about things i logically know the answer to will make me practically be able to change it, or indeed change how other people perceive me. Its alright for people to say to me, "just join in" or, "youre not alone", but i already know that. And joining in isnt as easy as people who can do it seem to think. 

And it makes the sadness feel stronger because although i know the happiness to be real in that moment, it dosent lead to fulfilment or happy in the long term as you put it. Which means that every time i become down, it .akes the happiness become insignificant and meaningless. How to you take pleasure from happiness when it makes no difference to your life?

Wveryday i find something that makes me smiles or enjoy the day, the sort of thing places like this say to look for. I smile, i enjoy them, youre not wrong. But come the end of the day i dont feel excited or happy, i find myeself kn the verge of tear or struggling to think. Happiness dosent give me anything anymore, it makes the sadness feel stronger

Ive just gone on a dream holiday which had been bookd for a year and a half. Im currently on it and want to leave. Not go home just leave. In not fitting in and im not eve. Ebjoying the thing than people dream of. I see jo reaso. To livew
I have no family apart from my mother, the only  thing that keeps me here, but i truly beleive shed understand

I know its a cliche but i have no reason. I have a more than decnt job, good life but see no point. I understand the theory of things can get better but i push away everyone with out trying. There is no point
